name: audio-engine-partitioned-convolution
title: Partitioned convolution for long impulse responses
description: Introduce a partitioned FFT convolution path for long impulse responses while retaining the current short-IR path.
scope: FFT convolution performance and long impulse response scalability
creator: Asaiuta
notes: Current overlap-save convolver is good for short/medium IRs; long room/reverb IRs need partitioning to keep callback cost bounded.

meta.routing_rule: Keep FFTConvolver for short IRs and add a measured threshold for partitioned mode.
